data.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?

result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For a small team, I'd recommend **1Password Business** as the best all-round password manager.

The important thing is to choose a manager designed for teams, rather than simply sharing a family or individual password vault.

For a small business, I'd prioritise\:

- **Shared vaults\:** Securely share logins without sending passwords over email or Slack.
- **Access control\:** Give employees access only to the credentials they need.
- **Easy onboarding/offboarding\:** Add and remove team members without disrupting everyone else.
- **MFA support\:** Protect accounts with multi-factor authentication.
- **Auditability\:** See who has access and manage security risks.
- **Reasonable pricing\:** Avoid paying for enterprise features you won't use.

## My shortlist

| Password manager | Best for | My verdict |
|--------|--------|--------|
| 1Password | Ease of use and administration | Best overall experience |
| Bitwarden | Cost and security | Best value |
| Proton Pass | Privacy-conscious businesses | Best privacy-focused alternative |
| Keeper | More advanced access controls | Best for security-heavy teams |
| Dashlane | Password health and risk monitoring | Good, but compare pricing carefully |


### 1\. 1Password — my overall recommendation

![Wachtwoordmanager 1Password | KPN](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/SR9cQiLQIFEFCALVJ5nUtWe25Q29qJVc5LjX65WdCnj5yzmD0dY1kGYKRcHN2028gLjEDLJ1Kkz4elZpmKF_3nFRDEJ56EPcrV1LwREU1riSDOE2qPsulZBrm1uLMFbZk3uGppXxaiJ5LZXh3ClEqc5wBJ1jJuMVahqzv5wwpeyD20eaUwi0i3WuDMRbtYuK?purpose=fullsize)

**Best for teams that want things to just work.**

- Excellent desktop, mobile and browser apps.
- Shared vaults and granular permissions.
- Strong administrator controls.
- Good onboarding and offboarding.
- Watchtower security alerts.
  
  Particularly suitable for teams without dedicated IT staff.
  
  [1Password business plans](https://1password.com/business)

### 2\. Bitwarden — best value

![The best password managers in 2026 | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/NzVuMgIchg5mHs-Kr9143cu9YVcLD78U-cfqnnpzpdksR6kB5LPVR6OyqUe0J0PAWilFgVX5RafeZ-AzNa_G6WUPgI8J1U4oAahEfqnQQL2SaxhVwFg9jy1o1kVewXMyq40iQ1cCkpkzpsh_DQntfgs6e3PLRpQFbO3dRcV-HQGbTSkVwYxuDvCJM657Aw6_?purpose=fullsize)

**Best if you want excellent functionality without spending much.**

- Open-source core.
- Shared collections and team management.
- Admin controls and event logs.
- Cross-platform support.
- Self-hosting options on appropriate plans.

Teams pricing is around \$4 per user/month on annual billing.

[Bitwarden business plans](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

### 3\. Proton Pass — best privacy alternative

![Test Proton Pass Plus - Gestionnaire de mots de passe - Que Choisir Ensemble](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ieWxaf1V1oKwR5RRYZyCUPTssuPFmf3KGImAFxDImLo918b9HrqSkmcFxYOmTtZlPSYlBfMDN2fRfrT9cxgSPcskegAU9CMbarL_OHz9CIE3qqDdr6RF19eJVNxO2Ol4ntEKr3D7ZAQzGf8y8YfFA_bGj9p5D2RwqWU6uGCUEvGwoAX0vUa7O4BZUHkNpExF?purpose=fullsize)

**Worth considering if privacy and European data protection are priorities.**

- Secure shared vaults.
- End-to-end encryption.
- Password and identity management.
- Integration with the wider Proton ecosystem.

[Proton Pass for Business](https://proton.me/business/pass)

These choices reflect current 2026 comparisons; the main trade-off is ease of administration versus cost and control. [toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.openideurope.eu](https://www.openideurope.eu/reviews/password-managers-for-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[geekchamp.com](https://geekchamp.com/best-password-managers-for-small-business-teams-with-shared-access-controls/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.itechguides.com](https://www.itechguides.com/the-6-best-password-managers-for-business-in-2026/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What would I choose?

- **3–10 employees\:** 1Password Teams Starter Pack is particularly attractive, with a flat price for up to 10 people.
- **10–30 employees\:** Bitwarden Teams if cost matters; 1Password if usability matters more.
- **A technical or development team\:** Bitwarden is especially compelling.
- **A business handling sensitive client credentials\:** 1Password or Keeper.

For reference, published US pricing in November 2026 puts Bitwarden Teams at around \$4/user/month and 1Password Business at around \$8.99/user/month. Check UK pricing and VAT before purchasing. ## Three questions to narrow it down

I can make a more precise recommendation if I know\:

**1\. How many people are in your team?**

**2\. What's your approximate budget per person?**

---

**3\. What will you primarily use it for?**
